Deadline 05/26/2026 SUBMIT A CLAIM $15.2M Valsartan, Losartan and Irbesartan class action settlement Settlement Aurobindo class members can receive a cash payment of up to $100 based on the amount they paid for irbesartan medications. Class members who have documentation of their purchases can receive a larger reimbursement of up to $200.Hetero class members can receive up to $40 for each 30-day supply purchased, with a maximum total payment of $120. Members with proof of purchase in excess of $40 for a 30-day supply may receive a higher payment without regard to the standard caps.Vivimed class members have not yet been specified, as the allocation method is to be determined by Class Counsel and reviewed by the court prior to the final approval hearing.
